environment: local developer workstation, Windows 11, Node v24.18.0
notes: All three CHG-008 defects are remediated and demonstrably so. The three sessions that produced false scope failures - SPEC-0003/ASES-0001, ASES-0003 and SPEC-0002/ASES-0008 - now report PASS with an SDD-V063 limited-state warning instead of an invented SDD-V058 violation.

The remediation was not clean and the record says so. TASK-020 took four sessions: ASES-0010 BLOCKED on a duplicate test-identifier declaration, ASES-0011 stopped at the fixture boundary, ASES-0012 stopped before the test plan, ASES-0013 completed it. Each stop was a real control firing rather than a detour.

One record was corrected rather than replaced: ASES-0010 notes first claimed nothing was changed in that session, which was false - it had implemented validate.mjs and rules.mjs. The correction is stated in the record.

SDD-V064 is WARNING, not ERROR, and the reasoning is recorded: an ERROR would force rewriting historical DONE task records or minting an exception, and an exception downgrades a finding to INFO, which is less visible than a standing warning.
Residual: sessions closed before TASK-019 carry no end-state evidence and can never be re-evaluated. SDD-V063 reports that rather than guessing.
